scripts.generate:app-artifacts: npm run generate -w @exactjs/sample-server-components && npm run generate -w @exactjs/sample-shipping-calculator
scripts.build: npm run generate:compiler-abi && npm run build:prerequisites && npm run build:native-compiler && npm run build:workspaces
scripts.build:bun-prerequisites: npm run build -w @exactjs/compiler && npm run build -w @exactjs/request && npm run build -w @exactjs/intl && npm run build -w @exactjs/testing && npm run build -w @exactjs/microfrontends
scripts.build:workspaces: npm run generate:app-artifacts && tsc6 -b && node scripts/compile-all-exact-packages.mjs && npm run build:chromium-devtools && npm run typecheck -w @exactjs/sample-puzzle-generator
scripts.build:typescript7: npm run generate:app-artifacts && tsc -b && npm run build:chromium-devtools
scripts.check:style: npm run format:check && npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:build-scripts && npm run test:packages && npm run test:framework-comparison && npm run test:apps
scripts.test:apps: npm run test -w @exactjs/docs && npm run test:server-components && npm run test:shipping && npm run test:sudoku && npm run test:puzzle-generator && npm run test:microfrontends && npm run test:intl
scripts.test:build-scripts: node --test scripts/compiler-abi.test.mjs scripts/development-process-lifecycle.test.mjs scripts/component-local-target-abi/checkpoint.test.mjs scripts/component-local-target-abi/comparison.test.mjs scripts/component-local-target-abi/framework-comparison-adapters.test.mjs scripts/component-local-target-abi/generate-report.test.mjs scripts/component-local-target-abi/internal-performance-adapters.test.mjs scripts/component-local-target-abi/performance-output.test.mjs scripts/component-local-target-abi/report.test.mjs scripts/component-local-target-abi/structural-report.test.mjs scripts/local-build.test.mjs scripts/native-compiler-source.test.mjs scripts/native-compiler-build-cache.test.mjs scripts/native-compiler-output-comparison.test.mjs scripts/native-compiler-corpus/discovery.test.mjs scripts/native-compiler-corpus/measurement.test.mjs scripts/performance/measurement.test.mjs scripts/start-vscode-extension.test.mjs scripts/vscode-extension-bundle.test.mjs && node scripts/component-local-target-abi/audit-native-reachability.mjs
scripts.test:bun: npm run build:bun-prerequisites && npm run build -w @exactjs/bun-plugin -w @exactjs/bun-adapter -w @exactjs/bun-test && npm run test:bun -w @exactjs/bun-plugin -w @exactjs/bun-adapter -w @exactjs/bun-test
scripts.check:publish: node scripts/check-release-manifests.mjs && node scripts/check-native-compiler-packages.mjs && node scripts/check-compiler-distribution.mjs && node scripts/check-package-agent-guides.mjs && node scripts/check-package-contents.mjs && npm run check:artifact -w @exactjs/chromium-devtools && npm run check:readmes
scripts.prerelease:check: npm run check:style && npm run check:source-architecture
scripts.check:performance-admission: npm run release:check && npm run test:router-v63 && npm run test:e2e:theme && npm run check:native-compiler-corpus
scripts.check:sample-builds: npm run build:kanban && npm run build:workbench && npm run build:sudoku && npm run build:puzzle-generator && npm run build:microfrontends && npm run build:intl && npm run verify -w @exactjs/docs
scripts.test:packages: vitest run --config vitest.packages.config.ts packages framework-adapters react-adapters plugins component-libraries --testTimeout=30000
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate:app-artifacts && tsc6 -b --pretty && npm run typecheck -w @exactjs/sample-puzzle-generator
scripts.typecheck:typescript7: npm run generate:app-artifacts && tsc -b --pretty && npm run typecheck -w @exactjs/sample-puzzle-generator
scripts.check:compiler-acceptance: npm run build && npm run check:compiler-acceptance:built
scripts.check:react-compat: npm run build -w @exactjs/react-compatibility && npm run check:react-compat:built
scripts.check:react-compat:built: node scripts/check-react-package-corpus.mjs && node scripts/check-react-conformance.mjs && node scripts/check-react-reconciler-compat.mjs
scripts.check:r3f-browser: npm run build && npm run check:r3f-browser:built
